text:
maria: Quick kickoff for ClearPath SI onboarding — want to sync training, cert tracks, sandbox access, and marketplace announcement timing. Can we align owners?

devin: I can own the sandbox + lab exercises. Need a list of target models and whether we should provision Dedicated or Hosted test envs.

clare: cc @maria — I’ll share the latest partner playbook and the onboarding checklist. Who’s the certification owner?

samir: I can run certs. Thinking 3 tracks: Analyst (read-only), Integrator (deploy & config), Trainer (can certify others). Quick pass = lab + 70% quiz. Suggest 2-week cohorts.

rachael: marketing note — we should gate marketplace PR until after cert v1 + one joint deploy case study. Tentative window: Apr 12–19. Need partner logos & quote.

ben_r: Legal needs to run a co-marketing addendum + updated NDA for sandbox data access. I’ll email redlines by EOD.

maria: action items summary: 1) devin -> sandbox + infra spec; 2) clare -> playbook link + calendar invite; 3) samir -> cert curriculum + pass criteria; 4) rachael -> PR window + assets list; 5) ben_r -> NDA/msa draft.

partners-bot: Created ticket #PRT-4281 for sandbox provisioning (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PRT-4281). Assigned to devin.

devin: quick q — will ClearPath need VPC/private deployment for labs or OK with hosted tokens? Partner said some clients will want VPC.

clare: we should offer both. I’ll add VPC checkbox to the playbook and ask partner for their typical compliance needs.

samir: provisional schedule (feel free to nit):
```
Week 0: Partner kickoff + access grant
Week 1: Integrator track labs (deploy + routing policies)
Week 2: Trainer track + cert assessments
Week 3: Post-cert enablement: playbook + handoff
```

maria: perfect. Let’s aim to have cert curriculum and sandbox spec ready by next Tue (1845200000). If we hit that, marketing can lock the Apr announcement window.

rachael: noted. I’ll request logos + partner quote template from ClearPath today.

ben_r: once legal posts redlines I’ll flag any sandbox data protection clauses — expect one minor change.

clare: added checklist item: "marketplace listing prep" and linked sample listing. Will send combined calendar for cohort options.

maria: thanks all — will follow up with a short doc and assign tasks in the ticket. :thumbsup:
